name: GPU Marching Cubes with Atomic Counter Emission
definition: A real-time isosurface meshing technique that uses one compute thread per grid cell to classify density, reserve vertex slots via atomic addition on indirect draw arguments, and write vertices directly into a capped pool, avoiding prefix sums.
summary: GPU Marching Cubes with Atomic Counter Emission is a real-time isosurface meshing technique that eliminates prefix sums by using indirect draw arguments as atomic counters to reserve vertex slots and emit vertices directly.
